definitions.explanation: A group that goes ahead of the main body to prepare the way, scout, or set things up. Used in military, expedition, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {先発隊|せんぱつたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The advance party reached the site.

examples.japanese: {先発隊|せんぱつたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The advance team prepares the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先発隊|せんぱつたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}り→送る：00742_okuru⟧、⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The climbing team sent an advance party to check that the route was safe.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{先発|せんぱつ}→先発：17735_senpatsu⟧ (departing first) and ⟦{隊|たい}→隊：03383_tai⟧ (party, unit, squad).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先発隊|せんぱつたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send an advance party
- {先発隊|せんぱつたい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{向|む}かう→向かう：01186_mukau⟧: to go ahead as the advance team

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本隊|ほんたい}: the main body / main force — the larger group that follows
- {後発隊|こうはつたい}: the following party — those who set out later
